rationale_summary: The grounded norms fall into three main groups: (1) general system of controls requirements for properties and establishments, which support the same CP criterion without cumulative effect; (2) a specialization relationship between a general blending prohibition and a specific mung bean case; and (3) a set of reassessment/treatment provisions that jointly support the same CP criterion.
